# vendor

## Overview
Third-party browser runtime dependencies vendored locally under `upstream/payload/vendor/` for offline preview and hosted CDN asset parity.

## Subdirectories & Boundaries
- [ag-grid](./ag-grid/EGM.md) - AG Grid Community (`v31.3.4`) UMD bundle and Quartz CSS themes.
- [highcharts](./highcharts/EGM.md) - Highcharts JS (`v11.4.8`) core and chart module bundles.
- [lit](./lit/EGM.md) - Lit (`lit-html@3.3.1`, `lit-element@4.2.1`, `reactive-element@2.1.1`) ES module bundle.
- [looker-extension-sdk](./looker-extension-sdk/EGM.md) - `@looker/extension-sdk@24.20.0` ES module bundle and Node.js browser shims.
